statements.sql:
-- 准备：两张小表，行数不同，含 NULL 与重复值
CREATE TABLE t1(x INTEGER);

-- 目标 SELECT：安全形态，预期等于 (count t1)+(count t2)
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT x FROM t1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT y FROM t2
);

-- 对照：等价形式，独立给出预期
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM t1) + (SELECT count(*) FROM t2);
columns: (SELECT count(*) FROM t1) + (SELECT count(*) FROM t2)

statements.sql:
-- 准备：t1 含重复值，使 DISTINCT 与物理行数不同
CREATE TABLE t1(x INTEGER);

-- 目标 SELECT：内层第一项带 DISTINCT
SELECT count(*)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT x FROM t1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT y FROM t2
);

columns:
(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT x FROM t1))
     + (SELECT count(*) FROM t2)

);
